# Dusty v2.0.1 - AI models stay put
This update fixes one thing, and it matters if you run AI models locally.

The Developer level cleans the tool caches in `~/.cache`. That folder is also where Hugging Face, PyTorch, Whisper, and older versions of LM Studio keep the models you downloaded, and until now a Developer clean selected those too. That could mean tens of gigabytes to download again, and `~/.cache/huggingface` also holds your Hugging Face login token.

**What changed**

- A Developer clean now leaves `~/.cache/huggingface`, `~/.cache/torch`, `~/.cache/whisper`, and `~/.cache/lm-studio` alone. This covers the panel, `dusty clean --level developer`, and unattended auto clean. The same check runs at delete time, so an older scan or a stale selection can't reach them either.
- If you do want that space back, a new **AI Model Caches** target in the Deep level lists your model downloads one by one. Like Ollama models, nothing is selected until you tick it, and your Hugging Face token and LM Studio settings stay out of reach.
- The new target's name is translated into French, Spanish, and Russian.

Everything else works exactly as in 2.0.0.

**Install**

```
brew install --cask yagcioglutoprak/tap/dusty
```

Or download `Dusty-2.0.1.dmg` below. It is signed and notarized, so it opens without a Gatekeeper warning. If you already have Dusty, it updates itself.
